onboarding.title: Setup Permissions
onboarding.subtitle: TapWisper needs a few permissions to work properly. You can grant them below.
onboarding.microphoneDesc: Required for voice dictation and audio recording. TapWisper uses your microphone to transcribe speech into text.
onboarding.accessibilityDesc: Required for global keyboard shortcuts and inserting text into other applications via simulated keystrokes.
onboarding.screenRecordingDesc: Required for reading selected text from other applications so TapWisper can process it with AI.
